# P1.17 — Landing, pricing page, onboarding, Showcase

Spec: `docs/tickets/45_P1.17__landing-onboarding-showcase.md` · run ledger: `docs/build/runs/P1.17.md`
**Stage A only** — code + deterministic tests at $0. Stage B (prod funnel verify, $0–$10) is
operator-gated → `D-P1.17-2`. The real Showcase essay awaits H5 → `D-P1.17-1`; this PR ships the
machinery against a deterministic fixture dossier — **no invented essay content**.

Stacks on `stevenvitali/p1-16-billing` (P1.16's `pricing.json` is the pricing page's single source
of truth).

## Summary

The public face + the first five minutes: the §15.1 landing (twelve sections in the v0.3 order, the
drop-zone hero with its client-side file hold, the locked headline, the honest-marketing lints), the
§15.2 pricing page generated from `pricing.json`, signup intent + the deterministic Showcase seed,
the §15.3 first-screen precedence, and the §3.5/§15.4 acquisition events — all theme-consistent with
the app shell.

## What changed

- **Landing `/`** (`apps/web/src/marketing.tsx`, `client/landing.ts`): the twelve sections in order
  (nav · hero · dossier · workflow strip · the seat · voices · live runs · models · proof · pricing
  · changelog+FAQ · final CTA); dark-default SSR with the shared tokens and no wrong-theme flash;
  the hero drop-zone holds `.md/.markdown/.docx/.pdf/.txt`/paste client-side (IndexedDB, ≤10 MB,
  extension allowlist on every path — `accept` doesn't bind a drop), posts a `landing.dropzone_used`
  beacon carrying a token + kind (never bytes, never a filename), and routes to
  `/signup?intent=review&held=1`; after auth `/app/new?held=1` rehydrates the file input via
  `DataTransfer`. No-JS: the hero form still GETs `/signup?intent=review`.
- **Pricing `/pricing`**: every figure derives from `buildPricingPageData()`
  (`packages/contracts/src/domain/pricing-page.ts`) — the ladder (Free honest pre/post-day-14, Team
  waitlist), the annual toggle's 15%-in-dollars, Essay-first cost-range cards (ranges across model
  tiers, never a single number), the Write·Review·Voice·Run·Account matrix, and the generated FAQ.
  `pricing.json` gained the §12.2 public forms (`costCardTerms`, `modelTierMultipliers`,
  `costCardShapes`) the cards compute from. A hand-edited rendered figure fails the contract test.
- **Signup `/signup` + intent**: `entry=scratch|outline|draft`, `intent=review` → draft, `src`,
  `held=1`. `POST /signup` validates and persists `entry`/`src` on `"user".signup_intent` at
  account creation only (returning users keep theirs; malformed values are dropped). `beginAuth`
  now takes a same-origin `next` so the intent survives the OAuth/magic-link `callbackURL` as
  `/app?entry&held&src` — the query is `/app`'s fallback intent source. The sent screen shows the
  deterministic dossier preview. `/invite` keeps the partner cohorts.
- **Showcase** (`packages/db/migrations/0037_showcase.sql`, `seed/showcase.ts`,
  `apps/api/src/showcase.ts`): `projects.showcase`; `provisionPersonalAccount` seeds exactly one
  read-only fixture dossier per workspace at $0 (idempotent). `showcaseReadOnlyGuard` 409s
  `showcase_read_only` on mutating verbs across run/editor/outline/finding/triage/chat/revision/
  version/figure/estimate/export/approval/import routes, while archive/unarchive/restore/duplicate
  pass through and delete keeps its own `showcase_not_deletable`. Duplicate mints a normal project.
  `GET /showcase` returns the dossier deep-link facts + the persisted signup intent.
- **Precedence (`GET /app`)**: carried `draft`/`outline` intent (persisted or `?entry` fallback)
  redirects to `/app/new?entry=&held=1` first — the dropped file wins; otherwise an unopened,
  non-archived only-child Showcase deep-links to its dossier `#finding-<first>`; opened/archived
  Showcase is just a row and never counts as the user's own work.
- **Acquisition analytics** (`acquisition_events` + `analytics_events`): `landing.viewed` +
  `landing.dropzone_used` on the pre-auth `POST /analytics/landing` (coarse props, SHA-256'd IP for
  dedupe, no PII); the session-bound `POST /analytics/acquisition` whitelist (`entry.chosen`,
  `outline.approved`, `paywall.shown`, `showcase.opened`, `showcase.finding_anchor_viewed`,
  `email.verified`); server-owned emitters at the real seams (`signup.completed`, `entry.chosen` on
  project create, `paywall.shown` on gate denial, `showcase.opened` on first dossier read, the
  finding-anchor scroll beacon via `/a/acq`). Opt-out honored via `recordAnalyticsEvent`; analytics
  never break the funnel. Emission-audit classifications updated.
- **Copy lints** (`packages/contracts/src/growth-lint.ts`): `lintGrowthCopy` fails CI on
  hero/proof generation promises, detection-evasion language (everywhere), placeholder
  logos/testimonials, unbuilt-asset claims, and comparative claims until `COMPARATIVE_WAVE_MET`
  flips (REQ-POS-4/5/11/12/13, REQ-GROWTH-5 amended, REQ-EVAL-19); the hero headline is pinned to
  the §15.1 string.

## Notable fixes

- A fire-and-forget analytics write in the run-gate denial path raced PGlite's single connection
  (`memory access out of bounds` across the suite) — now awaited, still non-fatal.
- Hono folds sub-app middleware into the shared router — the Showcase guard is path-aware and
  exempts the allowed lifecycle verbs (it initially swallowed duplicate/archive/delete).
- `EstimateApiDeps`/`RevisionApiDeps` gained an optional `db` for the guard (they mount outside the
  `if (deps.db)` block).

## Tests

New: `packages/contracts/src/domain/pricing-page.test.ts` (derivation + growth lints + fixture
contract), `packages/db/src/seed/showcase.test.ts`, `apps/api/src/showcase.test.ts` (10 — seeding,

acquisition channels), `apps/web/src/marketing.test.ts` (11 — section order, derived pricing,

`copy.test.ts`, `emission-audit.test.ts`, schema-parity — for the new public routes and the seeded
run row.
